question: Does the frozen multi-premia equal-risk blend (trend + cross-sectional momentum + funding carry) earn positive net returns on 60 crypto perps that no repository protocol has evaluated?
registration_note: Registered 2026-09-28 before any price or strategy result on these coins was computed. Selection used only MEXC contract metadata and 24h turnover on 2026-09-28.
evaluation_rule: run exactly once from a commit containing this file

selection_rule.pool: all MEXC USDT perps, state 0, ranked by 24h turnover on 2026-09-28
selection_rule.exclude_zones: tradfi, stock, index, forex, commodities, metals (conceptPlate)
selection_rule.exclude_used: every *_USDT symbol referenced in config/, docs/, research/, scripts/, src/ at registration (includes the 70 blend coins)

survivorship_caveat: current-turnover selection favours surviving coins; the tail is thin (~0.4M USD/day), so costs may be understated there.
rules: exactly multi-premia-v1 / multi-premia-blend-v1: legs {"S1_trend": {"parameters": {"DON8": {"lookback": 55}, "EMA8": {"fast": 24, "slow": 96, "min_atr_spread": 0.25}}, "target_annual_vol": 0.15, "sizing_window_bars": 180}, "S2_xs_momentum": {"lookback_days": 30, "rebalance_days": 7, "quantile": 0.25, "source": "frozen mexc_xs_mom30_7_dn_v1 rules"}, "S3_xs_carry": {"lookback_days": 7, "rebalance_days": 7, "quantile": 0.25}}; blend inverse 90-day vol, Monday; 20 bps; Binance funding proxy (symbol or 1000-prefixed), zero where unavailable, coverage reported

primary.pass_rule: mean > 0, Newey-West t (5 lags) >= 2.0, Sharpe > 0 in both halves
